verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a hosted commerce SaaS like Shopify, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of choosing a data storage region. The region-related items (Markets, 'Tailor your store by region') cover selling to geographic markets, not where merchant data is stored, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
